WITH counts_per_type AS (
  SELECT 
    o.ordertune,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) as order_count
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
with_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    order_count,
    AVG(order_count) OVER () as overall_avg
  FROM counts_per_type
)
SELECT
  AVG(order_count) as avg_of_counts,
  AVG(order_count - overall_avg) as avg_excess
FROM with_avg
WHERE order_count > overall_avg
